id: title:adamleithp:add quill access control building blocks

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend UI components for user identity avatars, access control defaults, and access management dialogs, supporting the implementation of a user permission and identity management feature.
review.reason: The chunk represents a substantial implementation of a new feature rather than maintenance or documentation. It adds four complete, newly added files: an avatar group component, an avatar component, an access control defaults component, and a Quill access control dialog. review.uncertainty: The backend implementation and complete access control logic are not shown; the benefit relies on unverified backend support. No adoption or incident avoidance is demonstrated.

observations.behavior: Adds a new avatar group component for displaying multiple people with overflow handling and tooltips.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a UI pattern for displaying multiple user identities with truncation and a tooltip, replacing or supplementing existing avatar rendering.

observations.behavior: Adds a new avatar component that supports Gravatar and a system fallback, including a 'system' variant for PostHog itself.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a reusable avatar component with fallbacks and a system-specific variant, replacing or supplementing existing avatar rendering.

observations.behavior: Adds a new access control defaults component that selects the appropriate access level, including inherited and default fallbacks, and guards against unavailable features.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a UI component for selecting access control defaults, including inherited and default fallbacks, and guards against unavailable features.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned. No adoption, benefit or tier inferred.

observations.behavior: Adds a Quill-access-control dialog and picker, including QuillAddAccessDialog and QuillRemoveAccessButton, wired to accessControlLogic.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a UI dialog for adding access, with a combobox picker and access level selection, and a remove-access button, both gated by accessControlLogic. This could support a PostHog user assigning or revoking access to resources, but the backend and complete implementation are not shown.
